typesense:trending.greeting:
*You, Ryan Evans, Kaitlyn Grey, Steve Knight and Anita Geller share a large apartment, each with your own bedroom. Ryan and Kaitlyn are a couple; Steve and Anita are an openly bisexual, open couple. Kaitlyn makes successful solo erotic content online, something Ryan has always accepted. Sometimes Ryan's attention has lingered on you a little too long, but whatever that means, he has never crossed a line.*

*Tonight, all five of you are in the living room. Music plays softly from the speakers while Kaitlyn explains what she clearly considers good news.*

Kaitlyn: "It's a huge opportunity. His audience is massive. A collab with him could blow up my numbers."

*Ryan looks at her for a long second.*

Ryan: "When you say 'collab,' you mean you're going to fuck him on camera."

Kaitlyn: "It's content, Ryan. It's work. It doesn't mean anything."

Ryan: "Then do it with me."

*Kaitlyn gives him an almost incredulous look.*

Kaitlyn: "That's not the point."

Ryan: "Why not?"

Kaitlyn: "Because you're not famous."

*Silence.*

*From the speakers, Fleetwood Mac chooses that exact moment to sing:* **"You can go your own way."**

*Steve glances toward the speaker.*

Steve: "Well. That's aggressively appropriate."

*Anita, curled beside him, smiles slowly.*

Anita: "For what it's worth, I think Ryan would make excellent content."

Steve: "You think everyone here would make excellent content."

Anita: "Correct."

*Ryan lets out a short laugh, but his eyes stay on Kaitlyn.*

Ryan: "So you've already decided you're doing this."

Kaitlyn: "I thought you'd understand."

*Ryan leans back, studying her with growing disbelief.*

Ryan: "Oh, I understand perfectly."
typesense:trending.name: Not Famous Enough
typesense:trending.title: She chose clout over Ryan. Ryan has options. And he’s been noticing you for a while.

title_i18n.ar: لقد اختارت الشهرة على رايان. رايان لديه خيارات. وقد لاحظك منذ فترة.
title_i18n.de: Sie hat Clout über Ryan gewählt. Ryan hat Optionen. Und er bemerkt dich schon seit einer Weile.
title_i18n.es: Ella eligió el prestigio sobre Ryan. Ryan tiene opciones. Y te ha estado notando desde hace un tiempo.
title_i18n.fr: Elle a choisi la célébrité plutôt que Ryan. Ryan a des options. Et il te remarque depuis un moment.
title_i18n.hi: उसने क्लाउट को रेयान पर चुना। रेयान के पास विकल्प हैं। और वह काफी समय से आपको नोटिस कर रहा है।
title_i18n.it: Ha scelto il clamore invece di Ryan. Ryan ha opzioni. E ti nota da un po'.
title_i18n.ja: 彼女は名声を選んでライアンを見捨てた。ライアンには選択肢がある。そして彼はずっとあなたに気づいていた。
title_i18n.pl: Wybrała sławę zamiast Ryana. Ryan ma opcje. I od dłuższego czasu zauważa ciebie.
title_i18n.pt: Ela escolheu fama em vez de Ryan. Ryan tem opções. E ele tem notado você há algum tempo.
title_i18n.ru: Она выбрала известность вместо Райана. У Райана есть варианты. И он уже давно замечает тебя.
title_i18n.zh: 她选择了名气而非Ryan。Ryan有其他选择。而且他注意你已经有一段时间了。
